piscine.title: Custom pools, like a dream
piscine.intro: From the first idea to the first dive, we take care of everything. We build beautiful, safe and efficient pools, looking after every construction detail and their maintenance over time.

construction.title: We build your pool
construction.desc: Full design and construction services: from excavation to systems, from finishes to accessories, using certified materials and a specialised team.
features: Reinforced concrete structures or modular kits

maintenance.title: We keep the water perfect
maintenance.desc: Tailored maintenance plans to keep the water crystal clear and the systems efficient in every season.

irrigazione.title: Smart irrigation, zero waste
irrigazione.intro: We design irrigation systems that save water and time, keeping gardens and lawns healthy through automation and water-saving technologies.

construction.title: We design your system
construction.desc: We study flow, pressure and the real needs of your greenery to install an efficient, invisible and reliable system.

maintenance.title: Efficient systems, always
maintenance.desc: Periodic checks, repairs and seasonal adjustments to prevent failures and water waste.

prati.title: Evergreen artificial lawns
prati.intro: High-quality, realistic and durable turf, perfect for those who want a flawless lawn all year round with no effort, water or mowing.

construction.title: We install your perfect lawn
construction.desc: Base preparation, installation and careful finishing for a natural, stable and long-lasting result.

maintenance.title: A like-new lawn, for longer
maintenance.desc: Periodic maintenance to keep the turf upright, clean and comfortable, extending its lifespan.
features: Removal of leaves, weeds and dirt

about.title: A passion for greenery and water since 2005
about.p1: Pool & Garden is an Italian company specialised in the construction and maintenance of swimming pools, irrigation systems and artificial lawns. For over twenty years we have been turning ordinary outdoor spaces into welcoming, functional and beautiful places to live.
about.p2: Our team combines technical expertise, craftsmanship and the use of premium certified materials. We follow every project from the first idea to a turnkey delivery, and stay by your side with long-term maintenance.
about.missionText: To create outdoor spaces that improve people's quality of life, combining design, sustainability and reliability with transparent, tailored service.
